methodology: The decomposition process involved identifying distinct, self-contained requirements and behaviors described in both the original research topic and the generated technical specification. Each atomic unit was defined to ensure clarity and specificity.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Lemmings are modeled using a finite state machine.
Lemmings can walk left or right.
Lemmings switch directions upon encountering obstacles.
If bumped on the left, Lemmings walk right.
If bumped on the right, Lemmings walk left.
If bumped on both sides simultaneously, Lemmings switch directions.
When ground=0, Lemmings fall and say 'aaah!'.
When ground reappears, Lemmings resume walking in the same direction as before the fall.
Being bumped while falling does not affect the walking direction.
Being bumped when ground disappears or reappears does not affect the walking direction.
A Moore state machine is to be implemented.
areset initializes the Lemming to walk left.
spec_atomic_units: The module defines a Moore finite state machine.
Inputs include clk, areset, bump_left, bump_right, and ground.
Outputs include walk_left, walk_right, and aaah.
areset initializes the system to walk left.
When ground=1, the Lemming resumes walking in the previous direction.
If bump_left=1, the Lemming switches to walking right.
If bump_right=1, the Lemming switches to walking left.
If both bump_left and bump_right are 1, the Lemming toggles direction.
Outputs are determined solely by the current state.
State transitions occur on the positive edge of the clock.
The FSM has three states: walk_left, walk_right, and falling.
